process.quote: The department must determine if the allegation is major or minor and whether it is appropriate to deal with the allegation at a local level or if it must be referred to an Assessment Integrity Panel.
The department responsible for the assessment in question will normally be responsible for conducting an investigation into any allegations.
The student has the right to respond to any allegation and seek impartial advice from the Students’ Union Advice Team.

outcomes.quote: If suspicion of an assessment integrity breach is discovered after graduation, the student will be subject to the procedure set out in these regulations which, if a breach is confirmed could result in the overall degree classification being lowered or the award being revoked.

definitions.quote: “work” means summative work of any kind submitted for assessment or opinion by staff of the School, including material submitted for upgrade to PhD status;
“exam” means work undertaken in an invigilated exam room, usually under timed conditions or an online exam format
“script” means a summative assessment written by hand or using a computer, under exam conditions;
“source” means the published primary and secondary material from any source whatsoever (including websites and/or online material)

“contract cheating” also sometimes known as 'Ghost Writing', or use of 'Essay Mills', or anything that constitutes commissioning (including buying or paying for) another person to complete an assignment, or part of an assignment which is then submitted as the student's own work.
